releasePlan.notes: Flag enable-player-login already existed (created by an earlier run tagged pr-34; same feature). Off in production and test, v1 unreleased, so it is reused as a fresh-flag whole-flag release of v1 (no targetVariation). Every anonymous visitor shares the LD context key 'anonymous-player', so a percentage rollout is all-or-nothing until per-visitor keys exist. In v1 only, ldClient.identify() switches the context key to the typed callsign, which re-evaluates invaders-shooter-sprite. The gate is evaluated once per session, before identify(), so it can't flip mid-session. Guardrail metrics should be global (e.g. game-started) because login metrics only produce data in the v1 arm.

Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
